Cloning REPOS

1.  Get URL for the repository you want to clone from GitHub.

2.  In RStudio: File \> New Project \> Version Control \> Git \> Paste the URL of the repository you want to clone \> Name Cloned Project \> Create Project as subdirectory (select folder/file path) \> Create Project

3.  Check Project Name, Git in Panel and Folder for .Rproj

Setting up Repository

```{r}

# usethis::use_git()  to initialize a Git repository

# usethis::use_github()  to create a GitHub repository & push the local repository to GitHub

```

IN R: Tools \> Project Options \> Git/SVN \> Check "Version control system" \> Git (confirm New Git Repository)

Workflow with GitHub Edit -\> Save -\> Stage -\> Commit -\> Pull -\> Push and Repeat

A - added D - deleted M - modified R - renamed ? - untracked
